extracted.intended_audience: authors preparing to submit manuscripts to Springer Nature journals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors to determine whether a manuscript fits a particular Springer Nature journal and how to proceed with submission. Focuses on checking journal aims/scope, recent published abstracts, using a journal-finder tool, and the initial editorial assessment process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review the journal's aims and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review the aims and scope of the journal on the journal’s homepage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare your manuscript's topic, approach and intended audience against the journal’s stated aims and scope to assess topical fit before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check abstracts of recently published papers
rubrics_metrics.description: as well as abstracts of recently published papers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read recent abstracts to understand the types of papers the journal publishes (subject matter, style, level of contribution) and to check whether your manuscript aligns with current content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use 'Find the right journal for your manuscript' tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Find the right journal for your manuscript will help narrow down the search to the most suitable journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the publisher’s journal-finder utility to generate candidate journals that match your manuscript’s content and keywords, helping you shortlist appropriate targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit via journal homepage and undergo initial editorial assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: If the paper is suitable for the journal, please submit using the Submit Manuscript button on the journal’s homepage. The paper will be submitted to the Editor in Chief for initial assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submission the Editor-in-Chief will perform an initial suitability check; if found suitable the manuscript will be sent for peer review, if not a transfer to a more appropriate journal may be suggested where applicable, and you will be notified of the decision.
